messages:
anya-corp: Hey support, our SSO logins started failing after an IdP rotation last night. Users see 403 on the login redirect and our app logs show 'SAML: audience/recipient mismatch'. We didn't change our app config. Can someone assist?

maria-support: sorry about that — can you paste the error snippet and the IdP metadata URL you have configured?

anya-corp: here's the error we see in our auth logs: 'SAML_ERROR: audience/recipient mismatch (AssertionConsumerService URL) - req_id=8c9f'. The configured metadata URL in our SSO settings is: http://idp.example.com/saml/metadata.xml (we were on http historically).

kevin-sre: that smells like a redirect or cert-chain issue on the IdP side. Can you run quick checks: `curl -I http://idp.example.com/saml/metadata.xml` and `curl -L` to follow redirects. Also check the cert thumbprint in the fetched metadata.

anya-corp: ran a quick curl here (from our network):
$ curl -I http://idp.example.com/saml/metadata.xml
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://idp.example.com/saml/metadata.xml

`curl -L http://idp.example.com/saml/metadata.xml` returns the XML but the TLS chain shows an intermediate cert that expired on 2026-03-10. We rotated certs but idp proxy added https redirect at the same time.

maria-support: thanks. Our metadata fetcher normally follows redirects, but we've seen a race where a redirect to a different canonical host/URL leads to caching the metadata under the original (http) URL and the cert not being revalidated against the final host. We're going to force-refresh your IdP metadata from the final https URL and reparse the signing cert. Proceed?

anya-corp: please do — this is blocking employee and customer logins. High priority.

deploy-bot: metadata-refresh job queued for tenant anya-corp, job id mr-20260317-1123.

alex-idp-engineer: FYI the IdP team did a cert rotation and also started redirecting everything to https behind a proxy. Some proxies return 302 with a cache-control, which can confuse some fetchers. Recommend updating the SSO metadata URL in your app to the final https canonical URL to avoid the double-hop.

maria-support: forced refresh completed (job mr-20260317-1123). We fetched https://idp.example.com/saml/metadata.xml, validated the signing cert thumbprint, and updated your tenant's parsed metadata. Can you test logins?

anya-corp: testing now... web logins are working for me — success! :tada: Still seeing failures from Android mobile apps (they hit the same login flow but some users get 403).

kevin-sre: mobile webviews sometimes cache the original http URL or hit different frontends that return cached 302s with the old cert chain. Two options: clear the app/webview cache on client devices, or update the app to request the https metadata URL directly. For an immediate server-side mitigation we can pin the canonical https metadata for your tenant so all infra uses that copy for 24h. Want us to pin it?

anya-corp: yes please pin it while we roll an app update — that would help. Mobile UA we saw: `Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12; Pixel) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/106.0.5234.62 Mobile Safari/537.36`.

deploy-bot: pinned_metadata job completed: mr-20260317-1123 -> tenant anya-corp (TTL 24h).

anya-corp: After pinning, Android logins look good. Thanks for the fast turnaround. Any follow-up items we should do to avoid future incidents?

alex-idp-engineer: best practices: always configure the IdP metadata URL with https and the canonical host (no redirects). Ensure the IdP serves full chain (including intermediates) and verify cert expiry before rotation.

maria-support: we will also file an internal bug to make our metadata fetcher more robust to host-changing redirects and to always revalidate the final TLS chain before caching. Ticket: REDWOOD-SSO-4571.

anya-corp: please cc me on that ticket and leave the pinned metadata until we confirm app rollout. Really appreciate the help.

maria-support: added you as watcher on REDWOOD-SSO-4571 and left the pin active. We'll monitor for 24h then close if no regressions. react :white_check_mark:

kevin-sre: quick repro notes for the eng team: 1) Configure metadata URL as http that redirects to https with different host alias. 2) Rotate IdP signing cert, ensure proxy returns cached 302 with old chain. 3) Observe recipient/audience mismatch errors on ACS and 403 for some clients. Attach logs: `SAML_ERROR audience mismatch req_id=<id>` 4) Mitigation: update app to canonical https metadata URL or pin final metadata in Console.

anya-corp: closing for now — web and mobile confirmed working after pin + app plan. Thanks everyone.
